# GitHub Workflows Configuration

This repository contains web applications and static sites, primarily:
- Shipboard Fire Response Training Simulator
- Analytics Dashboard (bubulkaanalytics.com)
- Static HTML dashboards and tools

## Active Workflows
- `static-site.yml` - Deploys static web content to GitHub Pages
- `disable-auto.yml` - Placeholder to prevent automatic R/Python package workflows

## Disabled Workflows
The following automatic workflows have been intentionally disabled as they're not relevant for this web-focused repository:
- R-CMD-check (R package testing)
- pkgdown (R package documentation)
- test-coverage (R package coverage)

If you need to re-enable any workflows, please update the workflow files accordingly.
